definitions.explanation: The layer of fat that lies directly beneath the skin, as opposed to visceral fat surrounding internal organs. A common topic in discussions of diet and body composition.

examples.japanese: {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}を{落|お}とす。
examples.english: To get rid of subcutaneous fat.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}は{男性|だんせい}より{皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}が{多|おお}い{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: Women tend to have more subcutaneous fat than men.

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}の{皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}を{減|へ}らすには、{食事|しょくじ}と{運動|うんどう}の{両方|りょうほう}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To reduce subcutaneous fat around the stomach, both diet and exercise are important.

notes:
Composed of {皮下|ひか} ({皮|かわ} skin + {下|した} under, "under the skin") and {脂肪|しぼう} (fat). {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう} is commonly contrasted with {内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう} (visceral fat) in Japanese discussions of health and dieting. Subcutaneous fat is the type you can "pinch" and tends to accumulate around the hips, thighs, and upper arms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}を{落|お}とす/{減|へ}らす: to lose/reduce subcutaneous fat
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}が{多|おお}い/{少|すく}ない: to have a lot of/little subcutaneous fat
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}が{蓄積|ちくせき}する: subcutaneous fat accumulates
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}{型|がた}{肥満|ひまん}: subcutaneous-fat type obesity

RELATED WORDS:
- {内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}: visceral fat — the type that surrounds internal organs
- {体脂肪|たいしぼう}: body fat (in general)
- {体脂肪率|たいしぼうりつ}: body fat percentage
- {脂肪|しぼう}: fat (general term)
- {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}: triglycerides
